records.title: Equestrian Training Academy in Public Schools – Riyadh
records.investment_offering_evidence: This opportunity sets up an Equestrian Training Academy inside public schools in the Riyadh region. It will build and run riding arenas, stables, and training programs for 250–400 trainees each year. Location: Al Iskan district, Riyadh city, on a site of more than 12,000 m², using land and buildings already provided by the Ministry of Education. It is the first academy of its kind inside a public school, helping promote horse riding as part of Saudi heritage.

records.title: Investing in Sports Facilities in Public Schools – Jeddah
records.investment_offering_evidence: This opportunity invests in and manages school sports facilities in Jeddah. It improves facility quality, encourages sports for everyone, and helps find and develop new talent, supporting the goals of the Quality of Life Program and the Ministry of Sports. Location: 6th Elementary Model School, Jeddah, on a 1,250 m² site. The project will build and run football fields, courts, and fitness areas, using land and buildings already provided by the Ministry of Education.

records.title: Investing in Sports Facilities in Public Schools – Dammam
records.investment_offering_evidence: This opportunity invests in and manages school sports facilities in Dammam. It improves facility quality, encourages sports for everyone, and helps find and develop new talent, supporting the goals of the Quality of Life Program and the Ministry of Sports. Location: Prince Mohammed bin Fahd Education Complex, Dammam, on a 3,000 m² site. The project will build and run football fields, courts, fitness areas, and multi-purpose sports spaces, using land and buildings already provided by the Ministry of Education.

records.title: Investing in Sports Facilities in Public Schools – Riyadh
records.investment_offering_evidence: This opportunity invests in and manages school sports facilities in Riyadh. It improves facility quality, encourages sports for everyone, and helps find and develop new talent, supporting the goals of the Quality of Life Program and the Ministry of Sports. Location: Mujahid Bin Jabr Elementary School, Riyadh, on a 2,200 m² site. The project will build and run football fields, courts, and fitness areas, using land and buildings already provided by the Ministry of Education.

records.title: CRO capacity
records.investment_offering_evidence: Establishment of CRO capabilities including drug discovery services and the running of preclinical studies and human clinical trials.

records.title: CAR-T cell therapeutics
records.investment_offering_evidence: Development of CAR-T cell therapeutics through investments in R&D.

records.title: Innovative cell therapy R&D & commercialization
records.investment_offering_evidence: Establish a research center for cell therapies developed from various cell platforms including stem cells, tumor infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL), natural killer (NK) cells and dendritic (DC) cells.

records.title: Longevity & wellness ‘omics
records.investment_offering_evidence: Investment in the space of longevity therapeutics and omics data, utilizing local infrastructure and data availability.

records.title: Longevity therapeutics
records.investment_offering_evidence: Investment in the space of longevity therapeutics, utilizing local infrastructure and data availability.

records.title: Gene therapy R&D & commercialization
records.investment_offering_evidence: Development of research facilities specialized in gene therapy, as well as investing in commercialization capabilities for gene therapies.

records.title: Clinical / commercial C&GT production
records.investment_offering_evidence: Establish an offering within cell and gene therapy (e.g. CAR T-cell), particularly focusing on rare diseases, infectious diseases and oncology.

records.title: Peptide DS manufacturing
records.investment_offering_evidence: Localize production of peptides from cell lines by setting up local production facilities.

records.title: Recombinant protein DS manufacturing
records.investment_offering_evidence: Establishing recombinant protein drug substance manufacturing, including fusion proteins and formulation.

records.title: Monoclonal antibody DS manufacturing
records.investment_offering_evidence: Establishing monoclonal antibody drug substance manufacturing, including antibody-drug conjugates and formulation

records.title: Innovative vaccine R&D capacity
records.investment_offering_evidence: Build a viral vector and nucleic acid vaccine-dedicated R&D infrastructure focused on cutting-edge technologies. Innovative vaccine technologies include mRNA, p-DNA and viral vectors.

records.title: Bio-based construction materials development
records.investment_offering_evidence: Development of R&D facilities and pilot plants for production of bio-based construction materials (e.g., bio-cement)

records.title: Cosmetic active development
records.investment_offering_evidence: Opportunity to invest in R&D and production facilities to develop more efficient and bio-driven production processes of active ingredients for cosmetics and personal care to leverage more stable and sustainable sources

records.title: Nutraceuticals ingredient development & production
records.investment_offering_evidence: Opportunity to invest in nutraceuticals ingredient development and fermentation-based production (e.g., of vitamins, amino acids, carotenoids, probiotics) used in functional foods and dietary supplements

records.title: Biological wastewater treatment development
records.investment_offering_evidence: Development of biological wastewater treatment plants, e.g., facilities leveraging anaerobic or aerobic microorganisms to decompose contaminants in industrial or domestic wastewater, or bioremediation for e.g., oil, mining industries, recultivating land, etc.

records.title: Cross-category industrial enzyme development
records.investment_offering_evidence: Opportunity to build a local technological platform within industrial enzymes by developing leading R&D, IP, manufacturing, and application infrastructure to unlock R&D synergies across end markets

records.title: Alternative feedstocks development
records.investment_offering_evidence: Build R&D facilities and pilot plants for algae or carbon-based production processes (e.g., laboratory for strain selection, plantation for cultivation, pre-processing facilities and refineries) to develop alternative feedstock for production of e.g., biofuels as well as adjacent use for wastewater treatment

records.title: Biological waste-to-bioenergy facility development
records.investment_offering_evidence: Development of biological waste-to-bioenergy plants converting waste (e.g., municipal solid waste, industrial waste, agricultural waste) to biogas, biofuels, etc. through microbial digestion or fermentation to divert waste streams from landfills and generate energy.

records.title: Synthetic biology R&D
records.investment_offering_evidence: Invest in R&D infrastructure to facilitate multidisciplinary synthetic biology research and attract MNCs alongside technology startups to leverage local research capabilities

records.title: Biopolymer development and production
records.investment_offering_evidence: Investment in specialized biopolymer production plants (e.g., PLA, PHA, poly-ethylene) or retrofit of plants to integrate bio-naphtha as feedstock, with adjacent R&D plants to drive development and commercialization of bio-based and biodegradable polymers and achieve price parity with traditional polymers.

records.title: Alternative protein development and production
records.investment_offering_evidence: Alternative protein development and production through e.g., CDMO-operated bioreactor plants for fermentation-based and cell cultured meats.

records.title: Biocontrol development & production
records.investment_offering_evidence: Establishing production facilities for manufacturing biopesticides, by cultivating and processing the natural sources from which biopesticides are derived, and establishing R&D to optimize formulations for local pest profiles and challenges

records.title: Biostimulants development & production
records.investment_offering_evidence: Establishing production facilities for biostimulants, including the sourcing and processing of raw materials, manufacturing, and formulation development optimized for specific crops and local soil conditions

records.title: AMBULANCE
records.investment_offering_evidence: Localization of manufacturing of repurposing kit and assembly of Ambulances in KSA

records.title: Compost Production Facility
records.investment_offering_evidence: Develop composting facilities to treat 300K tons/year of agricultural waste.

records.title: Livestock Breeding and Fattening
records.investment_offering_evidence: Invest in large state of the art commercial livestock farms, focusing on the optimal breeds i.e., Al-Naimi sheep (Awassi), Najdi, Harri, Dorber, Merino and Holstein cows

records.title: Integrated Potato Play
records.investment_offering_evidence: Invest in an integrated potato facility, farming optimal breeds (e.g., Hermes, Spunta, Desiree, Elite, and Super Elite, hybrid) to produce fresh whole potatoes as well as frozen and value-added potato products (e.g., chips)

records.title: Safe storage in Riyadh
records.investment_offering_evidence: A secure storage and high-value goods warehouse in Riyadh, serving luxury retailers, jewelry traders, galleries, e-commerce sellers, and high-value importers. The facility will provide private vaults, safe cages, secure inventory rooms, climate-controlled storage, insured handling, chain-of-custody tracking, packing / dispatch support, and secure pickup / delivery across Riyadh

records.title: Safe storage in Jeddah
records.investment_offering_evidence: A secure storage and high-value goods warehouse in Jeddah, serving luxury retailers, jewelry traders, galleries, e-commerce sellers, and high-value importers. The facility will provide private vaults, safe cages, secure inventory rooms, climate-controlled storage, insured handling, chain-of-custody tracking, packing / dispatch support, and secure pickup / delivery across Jeddah and the Western Region.

records.title: Private aviation facilities in RUH, Malham & MED
records.investment_offering_evidence: Development and operation of private aviation facilities, including Fixed Base Operations (FBO), aircraft hangars, MRO workshops, and VIP passenger terminals, across three strategically chosen Saudi airports serving Riyadh (primary business hub), Malham (dedicated GA node), and Madinah (high-value pilgrimage & VIP corridor). The platform captures demand from Saudi-based HNWI owners, corporate flight departments, and international charter operators

records.title: Development of aircraft spare parts manufacturing industry
records.investment_offering_evidence: Establish a KSA-based aircraft spare parts manufacturing and localization platform focused on high-recurring, non-critical and certifiable aircraft components identified from airline Required Spare Parts Lists. The opportunity targets selected parts with recurring fleet demand, high import dependency, and manageable certification requirements, serving Saudi and GCC airlines, MRO operators, and aviation suppliers

records.title: Relocation of regional hubs for e‑commerce and Courier Express Parcel (CEP)
records.investment_offering_evidence: Attract freight forwarders, 3PLs, e-commerce platforms, fulfillment operators, and CEP players to relocate regional logistics hubs to Saudi Arabia, anchored around Riyadh Integrated / SILZ. The opportunity targets bonded warehousing, air-freight transfer, cross-docking, fulfillment, sortation, returns processing, inventory buffering, and GCC distribution

records.title: Set up a GSE leasing and managed fleet platform for major KSA airports
records.investment_offering_evidence: Establish a specialized GSE leasing and managed fleet platform that procures new ground support equipment from OEMs, leases it to ground handlers, airlines, cargo handlers, FBOs and airport operators, and provides maintenance, telematics, spare-unit pooling and eGSE transition support. Selective sale-and-leaseback transactions can be used to secure anchor customers and recycle capital from existing operator-owned fleets

records.title: Chartered jets and fractional ownership services operator
records.investment_offering_evidence: Establish a Saudi-based private aviation operator offering on-demand jet charter, fractional ownership, jet cards, aircraft management, and premium flight support. The opportunity targets corporate executives, UHNWI / HNWI travelers, family offices, major events, luxury tourism destinations, and business delegations across high-growth nodes in the Kingdom

records.title: Aircraft Disassembly, Dismantling & Recycling
records.investment_offering_evidence: A dedicated aircraft end-of-life (EOL) facility in KSA offering full-spectrum disassembly, component harvesting (Used Serviceable Materials / USM), material recycling, and hazardous waste management — targeting Saudi, GCC, and wider Middle East airlines undergoing rapid fleet renewal, while positioning KSA as the region's first AFRA-accredited teardown hub.

records.title: Development of aircraft refitting industry
records.investment_offering_evidence: Establish a KSA-based aircraft refitting facility offering cabin reconfiguration, avionics modernization, passenger-to-freighter (P2F) conversion support, and VVIP completions, serving Saudi, GCC and wider MENA commercial carriers, cargo operators, lessors, business aviation operators, and government / royal fleets

records.title: Food security terminal in Yanbu
records.investment_offering_evidence: Development of a multi-commodity food security terminal at Yanbu’s Red Sea gateway, combining dry-bulk silos, ambient and temperature-controlled storage, food-grade liquid tanks, QC / inspection facilities, customs-enabled handling, redistribution, and optional re-export for strategic food commodities. The terminal will support grains, rice, sugar, edible oils, feed inputs, chilled / frozen foods, and packaged staples, strengthening Saudi Arabia’s strategic food reserves, import resilience, and western-region food distribution.

records.title: Attract logistics firms to support the oil and gas industry at SPARK
records.investment_offering_evidence: Develop and lease 49,000 sqm of bonded warehouse space at SPARK for oil and gas logistics tenants, including equipment suppliers, spare-parts distributors, maintenance firms, and specialist storage operators. The platform is supported by SPARK’s dry port, customs access, and energy-sector ecosystem, with future upside from tenant-led tank-container, bulk-storage, maintenance, and hazmat BTS facilities

records.title: Automotive Logistics Park – SPARK
records.investment_offering_evidence: An integrated automotive‑led logistics platform supporting vehicle import, bonded storage, PDI, and handling, complemented by spare parts warehousing, refurbishment, and GCC distribution/re‑export. The facility also enables bonded light assembly and servicing, and supports dedicated heavy equipment assembly and logistics (e.g., cranes, loaders), leveraging SPARK’s industrial ecosystem.

records.title: Development of marinas to support yachting and leisure vessels in Saudi Arabia
records.investment_offering_evidence: Develop a network of modern marinas across Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea and Arabian Gulf coasts, serving premium yachting, leisure boating, chartering, water sports, and coastal tourism. The opportunity will combine marina infrastructure, berthing, dry storage, fuel, utilities, maintenance, F&B/retail, and visitor services to activate coastal destinations and build a scalable marine-tourism ecosystem

records.title: Development of Jubail freight station
records.investment_offering_evidence: Develop a rail-linked freight station in Jubail to serve industrial cargo, port flows, and regional distribution. The facility will combine rail terminal yards, cross-dock, warehousing, truck staging, cargo handling, and value-added logistics services, supporting Jubail’s role as an integrated industrial and logistics hub

records.title: Development of the eastern entrance truck stop – Riyadh
records.investment_offering_evidence: Operation of a full-service truck stop at Riyadh's eastern entrance on the Riyadh–Dammam highway, providing full services such as fueling, parking, maintenance, F&B, and driver accommodation to commercial vehicles serving the Kingdom's most active long-haul route and GCC cross-border traffic

records.title: Expansion of logistics and industrial zones around King Abdullah Port
records.investment_offering_evidence: Expansion of port-adjacent logistics and industrial zones around King Abdullah Port within KAEC, positioning the site as a Red Sea resilience platform for bonded warehousing, re-export, light manufacturing, automotive logistics, cold chain, and supply-chain continuity

records.title: Jadidat Arar Cross-Border Logistics Center
records.investment_offering_evidence: A cross-border logistics center at Jadidat Arar serving Saudi–Iraq trade flows, exporters, importers, industrial distributors, food and FMCG suppliers, building-material traders, 3PLs, customs brokers, and regional re-export operators. The center will provide truck staging, customs-ready storage, bonded / controlled warehousing where licensed, cross-docking, inspection areas, value-added services, documentation support, and dispatch to Iraq and Northern Saudi corridors

records.title: Multi-Modal Logistics Hub in Yanbu
records.investment_offering_evidence: A multi-modal logistics hub in Yanbu Industrial City serving agriculture / food, chemicals, metals, minerals, and building-material flows across Madinah, Qassim, the Western Region, and export / re-export markets. The hub will provide rail-linked container handling, export and re-export zones, warehouses, bulk and breakbulk yards, value-added handling, customs-linked storage, and road / rail / port dispatch

records.title: Development of Dammam Regional Logistics Center
records.investment_offering_evidence: A large-scale regional logistics center in Dammam serving agriculture / food, chemicals, metals, and building-material flows across Eastern Province, Riyadh, Jubail, and GCC markets. The center will provide bulk and breakbulk yards, general and specialized warehousing, consolidation, customs-ready storage, value-added handling, multimodal transfer, and road / rail dispatch, leveraging Dammam’s port gateway role and future Land Bridge connectivity

records.title: Micro-Fulfillment Hubs in Riyadh and Jeddah
records.investment_offering_evidence: A network of urban micro-fulfillment hubs in Riyadh and Jeddah, designed to support fast-moving e-commerce, grocery, retail, FMCG, pharmacy. The hubs will provide compact Grade-A fulfillment space, ambient and temperature-controlled storage, picking / packing, rider staging, inventory pooling, returns handling, and last-mile dispatch to reduce delivery times and improve service reliability

records.title: Railway spare parts manufacturing and localization
records.investment_offering_evidence: Manufacturing and localization of certified railway spare parts, consumables, and track components in Saudi Arabia, targeting recurring replacement demand from SAR, metro operators, HSR systems, rail MRO providers, and adjacent industrial sectors. Initial products comprise prioritized opportunities for localization, including brake shoes, filter elements, springs, relief valve, wear plate, cable, machine banks, crossing helix, hoses, and battery storage

records.title: Industrial Valley Logistics Lands for Clean Industries in KAEC
records.investment_offering_evidence: Serviced industrial and logistics land offerings within KAEC Industrial Valley and SEZ, positioned for clean and light industries such as FMCG, pharmaceuticals, building materials, automotive, packaging, and logistics services. Providing serviced plots through long-term lease or freehold ownership, enabling investor-led development of manufacturing, storage, and distribution facilities near King Abdullah Port

records.title: Pre-Built warehouses units for logistic use (KAEC)
records.investment_offering_evidence: A pre‑built logistics warehouse development comprising 12 connected core‑and‑shell units, offered for sale and dedicated exclusively to logistics use. Each unit includes approximately 1,000 sqm of open yard space and a 115 sqm mezzanine floor. The development is strategically located near King Abdullah Port, enabling efficient port‑linked logistics operations and supporting demand from import, export, and regional distribution activities, with the possibility to convert them to bonded warehouses if needed

records.title: Integrated DG & Chemical Logistics Park in Jeddah’s 3rd Industrial City
records.investment_offering_evidence: A specialized Chemical & Dangerous Goods logistics park in Jeddah 3rd Industrial City, providing DG-compliant storage, cargo yards, tank / ISO handling, chemical distribution, and export / re-export staging. The park will serve chemical producers, plastics / rubber manufacturers, specialty-material importers, industrial tenants, and DG logistics operators.

records.title: Pilgrimage & Hospitality Supply Chain Center in Madinah’s Industrial City
records.investment_offering_evidence: A logistics hub for food, hygiene, and hospitality goods serving hotels, hospitals, and religious facilities across Madinah. The center will provide integrated cold and dry storage for pilgrimage and tourism operations, ensuring supply reliability and supporting the city’s role as a northern logistics gateway

records.title: Integrated DG & Chemical Logistics Park in Dammam’s 3rd Industrial City
records.investment_offering_evidence: A specialized logistics park providing DG-compliant storage, tank handling, and chemical distribution for Dammam’s and Jubail’s industrial base. The facility will serve as a secure inland consolidation point for chemical exports and inbound feedstock, enabling safer operations and attracting global DG logistics operators

records.title: Bonded & Re-Export Logistics Zone in Jeddah’s 3rd Industrial City
records.investment_offering_evidence: A dedicated bonded and re-export logistics zone in Jeddah 3rd Industrial City, combining bonded yards, warehouses, staging areas, and value-added logistics services. The zone will serve chemicals, metals, F&B, industrial tenants, importers, exporters, and re-export players, leveraging internal demand from Jeddah 3rd IC tenants and proximity to Jeddah Islamic Port.

records.title: Bonded & Re-Export Zone in Dammam’s 3rd Industrial City
records.investment_offering_evidence: A dedicated bonded and re-export logistics zone in Dammam 3rd Industrial City, supporting importers, exporters, industrial tenants, machinery / MRO players, petrochemical-linked traders, e-commerce distributors, and regional re-export operators. The zone will provide bonded yards, bonded warehousing, customs-linked storage, value-added services, consolidation, and redistribution, leveraging Dammam’s port, rail, industrial, and Gulf connectivity.

records.title: Agro-Food & Edible Oils Export Cluster in Jeddah’s 3rd Industrial City
records.investment_offering_evidence: An integrated agro-food and edible oils export cluster in Jeddah’s 3rd Industrial City, supporting food processors, edible oils / fats producers, packaging players, ingredients suppliers, and export-oriented F&B manufacturers. The cluster will provide processing-ready plots, cold and dry storage, packaging / labeling, quality-control support, export staging, and port-linked logistics to serve domestic, GCC, Red Sea, African, and wider international markets

records.title: Cold Chain & Food Park in Makkah 2nd Industrial City
records.investment_offering_evidence: A temperature‑controlled logistics park supporting food storage, light processing (packing and portioning), and distribution for the Hajj and Umrah ecosystem and retailers in the Western Region, enabling consolidated cold and ambient flows, seasonal surge capacity, reduced spoilage, and lower logistics costs with reliable peak‑period service for catering operators and organized retail chains (modern supermarkets and hypermarkets).

records.title: Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA)
records.investment_offering_evidence: Opportunity to develop Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA) production facility of ~10 KTA in KSA to cater regional and global demand

records.title: Adipic Acid
records.investment_offering_evidence: Opportunity to develop Adipic Acid production facility of ~150 KTA in KSA to cater regional and global demand

records.title: Tankers and Offshore Support Vessels Manufacturing
Drilling Mud Manufacturing Facility
records.investment_offering_evidence: Establish a drilling mud manufacturing facility to serve local and regional oil & gas demand

records.title: Directional Drilling Machines Assembly Plant
records.investment_offering_evidence: Set up a directional drilling machines (Mud Motor & RSS) assembly plant to serve local and regional demand

records.title: Water quality monitoring and control
records.investment_offering_evidence: The investment entails the installation, operation, and maintenance of water quality monitoring
